notes: Large-source unit 32 reviewed: אֲשֶׁר + אֲלֵי + הֶם → *whereunto* is a relative, preposition and resumptive suffix (3mp, referring to הֵמָּה the places) carried by one pronominal adverb; genuinely indivisible under rule 22/30, headed on the relative.
הֵמָּה → *the places* as lexical realization of the pronoun (rule 18); margin 'Hebrew they are' corroborates and decides nothing (rule 38).
